integrity_note: The scalar general-position number for the rook graph was known before this note. No publication claim or independent verification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to two complete-graph factors. Does not prove coefficient unimodality, real-rootedness or any asymptotics. Search cannot exclude a previously published equivalent enumeration of bipartite star forests.
title: General-position polynomial of rectangular rook graphs via bipartite star forests
